g.title: None.None.Node.1
g.text: AWS data lake and analytics platform in a VPC

g.title: None.None.Node.35
g.text: Apps stream click events into Kinesis Data Streams
Firehose batches the events into the raw S3 zone
Partners upload files over SFTP to Transfer Family, which lands them in the raw zone
DMS captures order changes from Aurora MySQL and writes them to the raw zone through the S3 gateway endpoint
Airflow on MWAA runs the pipeline on schedule
Glue cleans the raw data and writes the curated zone through the S3 gateway endpoint
EMR Serverless Spark builds aggregates and loads them into Redshift Serverless
QuickSight queries the curated zone with Athena, with access governed by Lake Formation
